hints.title: Running Line Accumulation
hints.text: Track the running horizontal width of the current line, wrapping to a new line whenever an element exceeds the hundred unit limit.

hints.title: Threshold Wrap Condition
hints.text: If adding current character width exceeds 100, increment total line count and initialize the new line with that character width.

hints.title: Return Tuple Structure
hints.text: Iterate through all characters sequentially maintaining lines count and current width, and return [lines, current_width].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Single pass simulating line wrapping with constant auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pre-chunking without character widths ignores variable font metrics.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Greedy linear accumulation with 100-unit boundary check.
